text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A decisive victory for Narita Brian! She's in a league of her own!
She's strong! Narita Brian is truly unmatched!
(――*snap*)

...Footage of Narita Brian's Japanese Derby,
which I have watched over and over again.

Once the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is over,
I will clash with her at the Arima Kinen.
She had grown so much since the Derby, and with her—...
—The day of the final adjustments for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The time... doesn't look bad either. Good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. With this in mind,
I'd like to request a meeting.
Just to be sure, let's also include the recent dirt records—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you. The word "perfection"
truly suits your recent work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, to the point it suits you far too well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that concludes today's meeting as well.
All that's left is waiting for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) itself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it an early night.
It would be embarrassing to oversleep in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. Do not let your imagination run wild.
It is merely advice that we should both be cautious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

Biwa Hayahide leaves the Trainer's office.
I should finish up the rest of my work too,
and get ready for tomorrow.

...Compiling meeting minutes.
...Current turf condition info for Tokyo Racecourse retrieved.

"...I replied to the email from that reporter we spoke to the other day.
...What else do I need to do?
...Am I overlooking something?"

"...Biwa Hayahide's recent exhaustion has been severe.
I should order the latest icing supplies and—"
(――*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...So you were here after all, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think I hadn't noticed
anything about the way you've been acting lately?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
“Narita Brian takes the lead!
In this race gathered with so many elite runners,
the one at the front is Brian!”
(*Click*...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Glued to the computer in a pitch-black room.
The unwatched TV left on in the background.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's even more infuriating is that the footage playing on screen is Narita Brian's race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Why carry it all on your own?
Isn't this something for us to research together?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What if you ruin your body at this rate?
I would be left to face the race alone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even though my "Winning Formula" was something I built together with you...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A mere "sorry" won't cut it.
I am angry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...You do not understand the importance of your own existence.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If not for you, I'm sure I'd still be hesitating
about whether to even make my debut."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
During the Classics when I competed against Ticket and the others,
I might have fretted over the gap between us
and sunk under the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You are the one who made me who I am today.
It is because of you that I am able to chase my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day I rebuilt my equation from scratch,
no, even before that! To me, you are...!

Biwa Hayahide's shoulders were trembling faintly.
Her eyes were just a little bit red, too.

The laptop screen open on the desk
had gone dark before I even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Make sure you get some rest as soon as you get home too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then lastly.
Let me say just one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If either of us were to lose a leg,
I would never be able to sprint toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because we run to "win."
"...From that day on, I decided to start going to bed earlier."
To bring about the "formula for victory" for Biwa Hayahide... no, for the both of them.
